Auch Wenn and Selbst Wenn: German B2 Exercises

Express concessions with auch wenn and selbst wenn. Practise verb-final conditions whose result holds despite the possible obstacle.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the rule

Auch wenn and selbst wenn introduce a concession that can involve a possible condition: Selbst wenn es teuer wird, reparieren wir das Dach. The result still holds despite that condition. Ob can mark uncertainty in other constructions, but it does not replace wenn in these fixed concessive patterns.

Common mistake to avoid

Auch wenn can refer to a factual concession or an open condition. Selbst wenn often stresses even the imagined case; avoid assuming that every clause states a proven fact.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice the form that changes and the role it plays in each sentence.

Worked example 1Selbst wenn es teuer wird, reparieren wir das Dach.Even if it becomes expensive, we will repair the roof.
Worked example 2Auch wenn ich wenig Zeit habe, höre ich dir zu.Even though I have little time, I listen to you.
Worked example 3Wir fahren Rad, auch wenn es leicht regnet.We cycle even if it rains lightly.
Worked example 4Selbst wenn alle widersprechen, bleibt die Frage offen.Even if everyone objects, the question remains open.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Keep the supplied concessive connector. Conjugate the verb in brackets in the present tense. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Auch wenn sie müde ___, bleibt sie freundlich. (sein)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: ist

The finite verb ist closes the concessive clause.

Question 2. Selbst wenn der Bus spät kommt, ___ wir pünktlich. (starten)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: starten

The main-clause finite verb follows the fronted subordinate clause.

Question 3. Wir versuchen es, auch wenn es schwierig ___. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: wird

Werden becomes wird with a singular subject and stands last.

Question 4. Selbst wenn du anderer Meinung ___, höre bitte zu. (sein)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: bist

Du takes bist at the end of the condition.

Use it in your own sentence

Say you will come even if it rains, using selbst wenn.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Selbst wenn es regnet, komme ich zum Treffen.

Check your wording: Selbst wenn introduces a hypothetical concession and puts regnet at clause end.

What to practise next

Change the subject or noun in one model sentence. Check the verb form, case and word order before comparing it with the rule.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
